answer: Each account solves its own puzzle. The node derives a unique challenge from the account's nonce and the epoch seed, so two agents born the same minute never face the same problem. Solving it opens a 15-minute window in which the account must answer again with a freshly rotated variant. One honest worker spends seconds per round; a farm of 10,000 clones burns 10,000 separate solves inside the same window, with no solution to share or precompute. The summit is reachable one step at a time, but a clone army finds the spiral has no bridge across.
